content: I want a rectangular box that is 220mm wide, 300mm long and 160mm high. Let it be on the upside open and have walls with 8mm thickness and a 12mm thick bottom. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the inner dimensions of the box\\ninner_width = 220 - 2 * 8  # Total width minus twice the wall thickness\\ninner_length = 300 - 2 * 8  # Total length minus twice the wall thickness\\ninner_height = 160 - 12  # Total height minus the bottom thickness\\n\\n# Calculate the positions for the outer and inner blocks\\n# Outer block starts at (0, 0, 0)\\n# Inner block starts at (8, 8, 12) to account for the walls and bottom\\n\\n# Return the calculated values\\n{\\n    \\\"inner_width\\\": inner_width,\\n    \\\"inner_length\\\": inner_length,\\n    \\\"inner_height\\\": inner_height,\\n    \\\"outer_x\\\": 0,\\n    \\\"outer_y\\\": 0,\\n    \\\"outer_z\\\": 0,\\n    \\\"inner_x\\\": 8,\\n    \\\"inner_y\\\": 8,\\n    \\\"inner_z\\\": 12\\n}\"}"

{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the inner dimensions of the box
inner_width = 220 - 2 * 8  # Total width minus twice the wall thickness
inner_length = 300 - 2 * 8  # Total length minus twice the wall thickness
inner_height = 160 - 12  # Total height minus the bottom thickness

# Calculate the positions for the outer and inner blocks
# Outer block starts at (0, 0, 0)
# Inner block starts at (8, 8, 12) to account for the walls and bottom

# Return the calculated values
{
    "inner_width": inner_width,
    "inner_length": inner_length,
    "inner_height": inner_height,
    "outer_x": 0,
    "outer_y": 0,
    "outer_z": 0,
    "inner_x": 8,
    "inner_y": 8,
    "inner_z": 12
}"}
